query: db.courses.aggregate([ { $project: { _id: 0, title: 1, null_status: { $cond: { if: { $eq: [{ $type: "$avg_score" }, "missing"] }, then: "missing", else: { $cond: { if: { $eq: ["$avg_score", null] }, then: "explicit_null", else: "has_value" } } } } } }, { $group: { _id: "$null_status", count: { $sum: 1 } } }, { $project: { _id: 0, status: "$_id", count: 1 } }])
